component.name: D!sco
component.summary: Build your own Debian or Devuan distribution for PC, ARM and Raspberry Pi

description.p: D!sco (Distro Custom) builds your own distribution from Debian or Devuan with Debian's own tools (debootstrap or mmdebstrap, chroot, squashfs, xorriso, live-build): a hybrid live ISO for PCs and UEFI machines, or an SD-card image for the Raspberry Pi. Other processors (ARM64, ARM, RISC-V) are built on this computer through qemu-user.

The Builder page holds the whole distribution: a preset, the platform, release, desktop, init system, installer and package lists with tick boxes, then Build all. Every part can be refined: identity and system files, users, language, kernel, boot loaders, boot menu, Plymouth, login screen, themes, sounds, welcome screen, bash prompt, browser policies and the Calamares installer.
